preserve: All vehicles and Doodle rendering use the public library pipeline and one selected MediumId.
The race remains playable with keyboard and touch, and camera mode changes never reset race state.
The Projection Studio charcoal, paper, oxide, green, serif, and monospaced visual vocabulary remains recognizable.
change: Turn the comparison instrument into an immersive racing surface with compact broadcast telemetry.
Provide a follow camera by default and an optional full-course camera.
Transform the narrow layout into a portrait playfield with large touch controls below the track.
discard: Twin projection stages, asset customization workbench, physical-solid rendering controls, and desktop-only minimum width.
Generic game HUD chrome, skeuomorphic steering wheels, and decorative controls without behavior.

productTruth.user: A desktop or touch user who wants a short, immediately playable arcade race rendered as Doodle 3D.
productTruth.primaryTask: Start a three-lap race, steer the player car against three opponents, inspect lap and position, switch camera or drawing medium without losing the race, and restart when desired.

coreCapabilities.description: Accelerate, brake or reverse, and steer through keyboard or touch controls.
Run a complete countdown, multi-lap race, opponent order, finish, pause, and restart loop.
Switch between a near-isometric follow camera and a full-course overview without resetting race state.
Render the same live course and vehicles with any public medium, using Oil by default.
Expose a retry path when WebGL cannot start while preserving selected settings.

acceptanceCriteria: Oil is selected by default and every public medium can rebuild the same live race presentation.
The follow camera keeps the player readable in a near-isometric view and Full course frames the complete circuit.
The race includes three deterministic opponents, three laps, position, timer, pause, finish, and new-race behavior.
Keyboard and touch controls operate the same driving commands with visible focus and no pointer-only action.
The responsive layout remains usable from 320 CSS pixels through the primary desktop viewport.
Every procedural vehicle and course carrier is rendered through SolidRig plus InkedSolidScenePass.
outOfScope: Network multiplayer, persistent leaderboards, audio, vehicle customization, track editor, and simulation-grade physics.

assetInventory.usageConstraint: Use the live-text AIND DRAWN name without inventing a mark.
Reuse the licensed Projection Studio Cormorant Garamond and IBM Plex Mono provider families without treating them as repository masters.
The inherited visual direction establishes charcoal framing, bone paper, oxide accents, and oxidized-green state cues.
All game imagery is live output from the public procedural library pipeline.

traits.instruction: The live paper circuit occupies most of the viewport; telemetry hugs its edges and never turns the game into a dashboard.
Pair luminous Doodle 3D paper with a near-black broadcast frame, thin rules, and opaque compact HUD slabs rather than floating rounded cards.
Follow and Full course remain adjacent, explicit modes with persistent race state and a non-color pressed cue.
Use editorial serif only for identity and milestones; all live race values and controls use tabular monospaced typography.
At narrow widths, move controls below the track in four generous drive targets plus pause and restart; never shrink desktop telemetry over the car.

content.provenance: User requirements and repository-backed vehicle, medium, motion, and runtime contracts; racer names are local fictional fixture labels.
useCases: Switch between follow and full-course cameras
permissions: anonymous local user may operate every control
errorAndFreshness: All state is local and current; renderer failure preserves selected medium and camera mode and exposes Retry.

representativeBecause.realTask: Seed 4107 Oil runs the requested arcade race from countdown through finish against three deterministic opponents.
representativeBecause.typicalAndDense: Four racers exercise ordinary ordering while the layout and model permit six without changing the HUD contract.
representativeBecause.adverseState: The proof covers off-road slowdown and a recoverable WebGL startup failure without discarding settings.
representativeBecause.coreCapabilitiesWork: Every declared drive, race, camera, medium, and recovery capability is connected to a live control.

structureConstraints: Keep medium, camera, and New race in the header without reducing the race field below 70 percent of viewport height.
Keep lap and position visible while the running order and keyboard legend remain secondary edge overlays.
Keep the field as the only intentional two-dimensional fixed surface and the page free of horizontal document overflow.

structureCompliance.summary: The desktop browser crop preserves the governed header, dominant field, edge telemetry, control inventory, and quiet status footer without horizontal overflow.

structureConstraints: Stack recipe controls above a square-biased race view, then place touch driving controls in document flow below it.
Use at least 44 CSS pixel touch targets and preserve pause plus New race without horizontal scrolling.
Reduce the running order to the current position in the field HUD while keeping the complete order accessible below or after the playfield.

structureCompliance.summary: The 390 pixel browser crop keeps recipe controls, field, full running order, pause, and four touch targets in document flow; 320 pixel inspection reports no overflow.

layers.instruction: Own landmarks, live telemetry, recipe controls, drive controls, error recovery, and status announcements as semantic HTML and TypeScript.
Own charcoal framing, paper containment, compact overlays, responsive transformation, focus, forced-color, and reduced-motion behavior.
Own no static illustration: build every visible course and vehicle carrier through public solid and inked-solid runtime contracts.
